title: Battle details v2
hypothesis: Saying what each battle action allows, with the game's own refusal messages (RUN refused in the PROF. BIRCH rescue and trainer battles), and spelling out types, abilities, stats and every move's type, power and accuracy for the foe and the party, lets the model pick FIGHT and a damaging move instead of trying RUN or the empty BAG, so more runs win the Birch rescue and later battles sooner.
notes: Registered pending 2026-10-15 on branch claude/battle-details-v2 (M2 of the harness-fixes bundle). The incumbent is the shared navigation incumbent with expanded-menu-battle-information-v1 ON, because battle-details-v2 needs it and the candidate must pass the dependency check; the first battle starts right after STARTER_CHOSEN. Operator foe-information policy 2026-10-15: show the foe everything. Provisional source.commit a85b591 (branch claude/r3-fixes, the parent of the round-3 fix commit; it contains this switch's implementation but not the round-3 fixes). It is repinned to the merge SHA on main with `just experiment-pin` when the bundle lands; until then this entry is not reproducible from main.
